observations: The brand 'YAMAHA' is printed in the center of the control panel in photo 0.
The model 'PSR-175' is printed on the right side of the control panel in photo 0.
The LCD screen is powered on and displaying a treble clef.
A prominent vertical line, appearing to be a crack in the plastic casing, is visible on the left side between the speaker and the keys.

The item shows physical wear and a visible crack on the casing in photo 0.

risks.risk: Structural damage from the visible crack on the left side.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the crack to determine if it affects the internal components or keybed alignment.
Photo of the power adapter and its connector.

proof_requests: A video of the keyboard being played to confirm all keys and speakers work.

response.reason: The model is clearly identified. While there is visible casing damage and functionality is unverified, it can be priced at the low end of entry-level Yamaha keyboards in 'as-is' condition.
